result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed, but there is one clear visual defect: the metadata line under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' has two text strings overlapping each other, producing garbled unreadable text. A couple of minor items were also noted.

issues.description: Under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar', the delivery time and delivery fee texts overlap, rendering as garbled text like '25–3€0rdelivery' instead of e.g. '25–35 min · €0 delivery · Ramen'. The two labels appear to be positioned on top of each other.
issues.suggestion: Lay out the metadata items in a horizontal stack/flex row with proper spacing and separators instead of absolutely positioning them at the same coordinates; verify the line renders as '25–35 min · €0 delivery · Ramen'.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is cut off at the screen edge without any ellipsis, so it's unclear if truncation is intentional carousel peeking or a clipping bug.
issues.suggestion: If the card is meant to peek off-screen, this is fine; otherwise apply text truncation with an ellipsis or ensure the card fits fully within the viewport when scrolled into view.

issues.description: The '€0 delivery' info appears twice in different treatments (badge on the Tokumaru image and again in the overlapping metadata line), which is redundant and contributes to the cluttered look.
issues.suggestion: Show the free-delivery indicator once (either the image badge or the metadata line) to reduce duplication once the overlap bug is fixed.
